annotations.title: What needs attention across your ad accounts

description: What needs attention across EVERY ad account the brand shared on Meta, Google Ads and TikTok, most severe first: accounts blocked by status or payment, spending limits reached or nearly reached, rejected ads, pixels that stopped firing, and ads connections that need reconnecting. An account that could not be read is listed as not read, never left out, so an empty list means read and nothing wrong. Each alert has a stable id; action dismiss with alertId hides it for this brand for 30 days (it comes back if the problem is still there). Read-only apart from the dismissal, free.

alertId.description: dismiss: the alert’s id from list
